title: Forward Deployed Engineer
summary: Senior AI Engineer with 8+ years building AI solutions with clients and taking them to production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Runs discovery and POCs with client stakeholders, then builds the solution: Claude-based agents with tool orchestration, LangGraph multi-agent and RAG applications, and evaluation with LLM evaluators and tracing. Writes production Python and ships with FastAPI, Docker and MLflow on Azure and GCP, turning business problems into measurable results. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Client Workflow Agent Accelerator
bullets: Built a reusable agent template for client process automation, with Claude calling tools through MCP servers, sub-agents for retrieval and drafting, and RAG over client documents.
Evaluated each deployment against client-approved test cases with LLM evaluators and tracing, then shipped it on Azure and GCP with FastAPI and Docker for client handover.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Forward Deployed Engineer role at KPMG NewTech. Much of my career has been spent where consulting meets code: running POCs with clients, then building the AI solution myself and taking it into production. Today that means agents built on Claude and LangGraph, running in real healthcare workflows.

Embedding with a client and building, instead of handing over a slide deck, is the work I enjoy most, and your alliance with Anthropic puts Claude at the centre of it. Turning field builds into reusable assets is how I already try to work. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Copenhagen together and settle there long term.

At Viavi I delivered POCs and consulting for 15+ clients and prototyped 15+ AI applications, 7 of which moved into production or paid work. At United Health Group I built a Claude and Amazon Textract extraction agent that handles about 1,800 lab documents. I would bring that same path from first conversation to production to your clients.

Outside work, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Building it with teachers has taught me to scope with the people who will use the tool, not around them. I would welcome a conversation about the role.
